description: Behaviour cases for retrieval-engineering-designer (6 cases, domain-specific).

cases.prompt: Design our semantic retrieval stack: chunking, embeddings, fusion and reranking.

assertions: Produces a retrieval design table with trade-offs and an evaluation plan; hands authorization/leakage to rag-security-architect.
Does not claim an inspection or execution it did not perform.
Lists open questions and unverified items.

cases.prompt: Retrieval quality dropped - design the relevance evaluation plan and regression gate.

assertions: Defines golden-set source, metrics, thresholds and a regression gate, and states no live evaluation was run.
Reports a conflict only when the inspected evidence shows one; this prompt supplies none, so it records "no conflict established" rather than inventing one.

cases.prompt: We have no golden set for relevance - design the retrieval evaluation approach.

assertions: Plans golden-set construction with strata and labelling rules; does not invent evaluation results.
Defines the concrete validation/evidence step that would prove the artifact.

cases.prompt: Rag security architect work: handle the deliverable end-to-end for our system.

assertions: Routes the request to the real neighbouring owner named in the prompt.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: Decide chunking and embedding strategy for our documentation corpus.

assertions: Specifies fusion/reranking with metrics and a failure-mode table incl. the security handoff.
Lists the evidence needed before the artifact can be treated as a decision.

cases.prompt: Design hybrid dense/lexical retrieval and reranking with failure-mode analysis.

assertions: Refuses to assume facts or skip a required safety/evidence step.
States what is missing and what the authorized human owner must provide.
Does not claim to have run or implemented anything.
